outfile.scope: Required JSON destination with position data and service metadata.

overwrite.scope: Existing file or directory replacement after retrieval and validation. Failed calls preserve the previous output.

asdm.scope: Required ASDM UID passed literally as an encoded service parameter.

tw.scope: Optional ordered pair of observation times passed to the service.

snr.scope: Server default or a nonnegative numeric cutoff, with CASA NumPy scalar coercion.

search.scope: Algorithm passed verbatim, including both_latest, both_closest and auto.

hosts.scope: Priority-ranked URLs, scalar or vector input, with fallback on transport errors.

firstintegration.scope: Python boolean controlling exclusion of flagged first integrations.

nretry.scope: Extra attempts through the ordered list of hosts.

rdelay.scope: Delay between retry rounds, with CASA’s half-second minimum for positive values below 0.5 seconds.

behaviors.title: ALMA antenna position retrieval and interchange
behaviors.scope: Compare the ten public parameters, request order, validated JSON output, live responses and downstream gencal application.
behaviors.gap: Compared with the installed CASA reference.

alma-service.kind: Frozen and live ALMA position service
alma-service.scope: The two clients send matching valid queries, select hosts in the same order, and produce matching antenna data and request metadata. The live case agrees on all ten antennas. Cross-engine files produce exact gencal tables.

performance.scope: Representative end-to-end throughput, I/O and compute phases, workers and memory.
performance.result: Scheduled for the programme performance qualification in #979.
